description: This file contains the MainActivity class for an Android application. It demonstrates the use of borderless buttons from the Holo visual style, presenting a list with touch targets and handling menu options to open documentation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity extends ListActivity; it displays a list and handles button click events, including opening a URL in the browser.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, adapters, and button click listeners.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically opening a URL via implicit intent.
